channel.title: RasanAI Studio updates
channel.description: Signed community beta updates for RasanAI Studio on Apple Silicon.

item.title: RasanAI Studio 0.21.0 beta 1
item.description: - **Ask Rasan how long it will take.** In the chat, "how long will it take?" and "what is happening?" are answered on the spot from the film's real progress, without interrupting the work. - **Notes become real change requests.** A message like "don't use this font" is read as a revision request the engine acts on and answers (an unclear one asks you to confirm first), and the answer shows in the chat. - **Edit elements on the final film.** Click an element in the final picture to move or resize it; the engine applies the edit and says if it could not. Early foundation, not tested end to end. - **Delivery details are collapsed** in the export sheet until you open them. - **Behind the scenes:** the groundwork for undo and revisions, and for safer recovery when a step fails, is in. Not yet tested end to end.

item.title: RasanAI Studio 0.20.1 beta 1
item.description: - **The film status says what Rasan is doing.** After you send something, the bar shows what Rasan is working on, how long it has been, and a time estimate when there is one. If nothing has happened after two minutes it says so and offers Show log. - **Decisions newest first.** The Decisions panel lists the newest decision first and shows the current step while Rasan works or waits for you. - **Installs are explained.** When Rasan needs a tool installed, Studio asks you directly, installs it for you without a password or Homebrew, and shows what is happening. If a command is blocked, or Rasan goes quiet for five minutes, you see exactly what happened, with Retry step and Restart Rasan.

item.title: RasanAI Studio 0.20.0 beta 1
item.description: - **Reference chip.** A film with a linked reference video shows a reference chip and, on Look, a Motion inspiration summary (cuts, rhythm, uncertainties) with a way to send the director a note on how much it should influence the film. Shown only when the film has `reference-motion.json`. - **Motion library on Look.** A collapsed Motion library lists the motion kit catalog; asking for an item sends a note to the director with the item, its annotation and parameters. Shown only when a catalog exists. - **Final element inspector.** When the film has an element index, clicking the video also resolves the element under the point, and a change request is sent to the director as a `motion-edit` action with an edit status chip (requested, accepted, applied, rendered, failed). Studio never edits scene files itself. - These screens are new and have not yet been opened in a window for review.

item.title: RasanAI Studio 0.19.9 beta 1
item.description: - **Help opens the new How it works page**, which follows one film through the app, the crew, the engine and the files on your disk.

item.title: RasanAI Studio 0.19.8 beta 1
item.description: - **Hover a note on the timeline and see that note.** Each pin answered for the whole timeline, so one note's card showed wherever the pointer was; each pin now shows its own. The card and the time under the pointer sit just above the timeline, where the video no longer covers them. - **A smoother timeline.** Only the playhead follows the clock now, so the video and the scene thumbnails stop redrawing thirty times a second, and dragging the playhead seeks to the nearest frame it can reach quickly, then lands exactly when you let go. - **Studio's own full screen.** Full screen (F) shows the film edge to edge with its pins and captions, and the timeline, notes and controls in a bar that fades while it plays. Esc or F comes back; C or a pin takes you to the chat with that moment. - **Your call wakes the director.** A call made on a film whose director had stopped used to sit unread, and the page never moved. Studio now starts the director to apply it, so the crew member comes to the centre and gets to work. Pin notes still wait for Apply, and a plan-limit wait keeps its own resume. - **Rasika has both eyebrows when she asks.** Her asking pose (Final, and checks) drew only the right brow; the left one is back. - **The sample film shows the crew at work.** Make a call in the sample and the crew member for the next step comes to the centre with the work in bubbles around them, then steps aside to ask before the sample returns.

item.title: RasanAI Studio 0.19.7 beta 1
item.description: - **Chat with Rasan.** The right sidebar is a chat with Rasan, the director: tell him what you want or what to avoid, with suggestions to start from. Open it with ⌥⌘B (⌥⌘I and ⌘K work too). - **Point at the film.** Click the video to mark a spot, drag a box, or circle an area: the chat opens with that frame, your mark and the time attached. - **A real player on Final.** Speed, loop, volume, full screen, ±5 s and frame steps, J/K/L, and a filmstrip timeline with your notes pinned on it. - **Preview is now Storyboard.** It was always key frames timed to the music, so it now looks like a storyboard: numbered panels with time, line and voice, and Play with music. - **Describe and Setup are one step.** The stepper reads Describe · Brief · Story · Look · Storyboard · Final. - **Calmer, even layout.** Equal 20 pt gutters on every page, panels that stay put while their content scrolls, a slimmer bottom bar with Pause and an honest "the director is stopped" with Resume, look options above the preview, and Preview and Final laid out like Look. - **The crew, drawn better.** A new speech bubble tinted per character that hugs its words and points at the speaker's mouth, readable highlight colours, Kavi's papers no longer see-through, and Rasan never cropped into a circle. - **Clearer buttons.** "Apply notes" is now "Revise with N notes"; "Preview again" is gone.

item.title: RasanAI Studio 0.19.6 beta 1
item.description: - **The crew asks, properly.** Every stage opens with the crew member at full size asking the question in a new speech bubble: one smooth outline with a curved tail toward the speaker, sized to the words, soft depth, and a small pop as it appears. - **Story and Look use the whole window.** On wide windows the character, question and your choices sit on the left; the script, or the look preview, runs top to bottom on the right. The selected look's details now sit beside the tiles instead of under the preview. - **One floating bar at the bottom.** The status and actions live in a full-width glass bar that content scrolls under, like the sidebar. Looking back at a step keeps "Back to now" and "Change this…" there; the separate green "Decided" strip is gone, since the stepper and the highlighted choice already show it.

item.title: RasanAI Studio 0.19.5 beta 1
item.description: - **Story and Look stay in view.** The review workspace keeps your choices and key context visible while detailed scripts and look guidance scroll in their own panels. The existing action bar remains available, including when looking back at an earlier decision.

item.title: RasanAI Studio 0.19.4 beta 1
item.description: - **Pause holds after a relaunch.** Pausing a film that Studio picked back up after a restart (by you, or by its own stuck or budget check) now really pauses it; before, the director was stopped and had to start over from its saved state.

item.title: RasanAI Studio 0.19.3 beta 1
item.description: - **A stuck director pauses itself.** When Claude repeats the same step, or burns tokens without showing you anything new, for two minutes, Studio pauses it so a loop stops spending tokens. A red banner says why, with Resume, Message Claude and Show log; nothing is lost and Resume carries on mid-step. Turn it off in Settings → "Pause the director when it looks stuck". - **Your budget is a limit, not just a warning.** When a film passes your spend per film, the director pauses. Keep going resumes it; Raise by $10 lifts the limit. - **Loops are caught even with Studio closed.** If Studio crashes or is force-quit mid-film, the director's supervisor stops it after the same call five times in a row instead of letting it run on unwatched.

item.title: RasanAI Studio 0.19.2 beta 1
item.description: - **Decisions say where you made them.** A call answered from another app (Squeak on your iPhone) shows "You · iPhone" in the Decisions drawer.

item.title: RasanAI Studio 0.19.1 beta 1
item.description: - **Honest time estimates.** Elapsed time and "time left" leave out the hours nothing ran (a Claude plan limit, a pause, the app closed) and stop while it is your call. Estimates start from how long real films take (about 1 h 45 min of work for a 30 s film, not 2.5 h), and no longer count down while you decide. - **Films pick themselves back up.** Quitting or updating Studio mid-film no longer strands it: a director still working is picked back up (never a second one on the same film), a plan limit still resumes by itself when it resets, and an unexpected stop resumes once. - **A stopped film says so.** When nothing is working on a film, it says "Claude stopped working on this film" with a Resume button, instead of a working screen stuck on "18 min left".

item.title: RasanAI Studio 0.19.0 beta 1
item.description: - **Edit a talking-head cut by its words.** The Cut step shows the transcript with Claude's suggested cuts (retakes, false starts, "wait, let me start again", fillers) marked. Cut or restore any phrase, accept or keep a suggestion, fix a misspelled name, and undo or redo with ⌘Z / ⇧⌘Z. Your decisions are kept if you quit and reopen. - **Notes can point at a word,** so Claude fixes the exact moment, even when the same word is said more than once. - **Updated Heresay** (the Report button) to 0.2.34.

item.title: RasanAI Studio 0.18.0 beta 1
item.description: - **The crew on the working screen.** Film progress puts the phase's crew member big in the centre with live eyes, and the newest real activity as thought bubbles. Paused, they snooze; when a call waits on you, they step aside and ask. - **Setup in three buttons: Claude, Codex, Tools.** One click does the next step: install, sign in, or make it your director. Tools installs the missing rendering tools right there. - **Sign in without Terminal.** Claude and Codex sign in from inside Studio: your browser opens, and there is a box for the code Claude shows. Use Terminal instead is still there. - **Codex is found when it is signed in.** A Codex that Studio installed now passes its sign-in check, and one installed after launch is picked up in Settings. - **Notifications are on.** Studio asks macOS once, after setup, and Settings says when macOS has them turned off, with a button to fix it.

item.title: RasanAI Studio 0.17.1 beta 1
item.description: - **⌘K jumps to search,** everywhere but a film page, where ⌘K still writes to the agent. - **A yes to the transcriber installs it.** Studio installs the speech transcriber itself, checks it works, and shows the real reason if it can't. The film no longer carries on without transcripts after you said yes. - **The old activity page is gone.** View activity shows what happened, newest first; a warning's View details shows that warning. Wrap up research sits right on the research budget warning. - **Brand in the + menu.** Pick a brand or add a brand kit folder or .zip from the prompt box. A folder that looks like a brand kit asks before it goes in as footage, and a film waits for its brand to finish compiling. - **The full storyline on the Story call,** beat by beat: what you see, what it proves, why it's there, the turn and the ending. - **Better time estimates.** They fit the film (length, scenes, pace), leave out phases it skips, learn from your past films, stay steady, and show a range until they're sure.

item.title: RasanAI Studio 0.17.0 beta 1
item.description: - **Upload a brand kit folder.** New Brand takes a folder or .zip. RasanAI copies every usable file, then Claude compiles the brand in the background: DESIGN.md, logo roles, fonts, media tags and the guidelines' rules. A progress card shows where it is, with Cancel. - **What Claude found, on the brand page.** A short summary, its questions in Needs attention, the files it couldn't use and why, and a Brand rules section. Recompile from kit runs it again and keeps your fixes.

item.title: RasanAI Studio 0.16.0 beta 1
item.description: - **Brands get an Assets section.** Logos with a kind (mark, wordmark, lockup, app icon), colour versions and a primary star; font files with their family, weight and style; screenshots, images, icons, video and guideline PDFs with tags. Drop files on a group or use its + button. - **Importing a DESIGN.md brings its files.** Logos, fonts and images the file points to are copied into the brand. A Needs attention strip lists anything missing, with Locate…, and warns when a font has no file and would become Inter. - **Your brand is the one in the film.** A film made with a brand now uses its logos and fonts, and RasanAI no longer researches the brand on the web. Switching brands clears the old brand's files, and older DESIGN.md backups are kept. - **The mascot is called Rasan everywhere.**

item.title: RasanAI Studio 0.15.1 beta 1
item.description: - **Fixes a crash at launch in 0.15.0.** Home now finds the crew artwork inside the installed app instead of stopping the app when it looks in the wrong place. - **Updates arrive sooner.** Studio checks for a new version every hour instead of every 5 hours.

item.title: RasanAI Studio 0.15.0 beta 1
item.description: - **The crew on Home.** Ra and the six crew members stand on the prompt box's rim over a soft mesh wash, and each one has a role in making the film. Scrolling down carries the prompt into your workspace, with your films as cards. - **Pages load calmly.** A page that is still reading shows a quiet loading state instead of a blank or a jump, and film posters come from a thumbnail cache, so the library and Inspiration scroll smoothly. - **Calmer working screens.** The sidebar rows and the window chrome are shared by every page, with keyboard focus on the sidebar. The status bar floats as glass at the bottom, and the working screen keeps to the film, with the phase rail one toggle away. - **Settings is a page in the window,** reached from the sidebar like any other place. - **The brief as named fields.** Each part of the brief is its own editable field, with the evidence it came from beside it. - **The inspector starts closed.** Cmd-K opens Notes. - **A Finished page with an export panel.** The delivered film sits beside one panel for its title, files, export and series look. - **Columns that adapt** to the window's width on the library and stage pages.

item.title: RasanAI Studio 0.14.0 beta 1
item.description: - **New film is a step-by-step setup.** One question per screen with big tiles: series, what you're making, material, brief, length and shape (read from the clip for footage), an example edit, the taste questions, then Review. The Home box keeps a one-click Start next to a new "Set it up". - **Review says where each answer came from:** You, From your clip, From your series, From your example, or RasanAI decides. Pace, Models, Motion, Brand, Director and Inspiration sit in a collapsed "More settings". - **Series.** Each series has its own page and lives in `<library>/Series/<slug>/series.json`. Existing templates become series on first launch, with the old data kept. On the film page, "Make this the <series> look" locks the look. - **Learn from an example edit.** Dropping an edit you like runs a short background job that reads it and pre-fills the answers.

item.title: RasanAI Studio 0.13.0 beta 1
item.description: - **A render is never "Quiet".** While a render or encode runs on your Mac (finish, render, ffmpeg, HyperFrames or Remotion), the film reads "Rendering" with the time so far, for up to 90 minutes, and says that tokens and cost hold still until it finishes. The status bar and the director monitor no longer call it "No activity". - **One tracker while Claude works.** The five-call step capsule steps aside while the progress view is up; its phase list marks the phases that end in your call. The capsule returns for each call. - **Film cards keep their shape.** A portrait or square poster is cropped to fill the 16:9 card instead of making it taller. - **Heresay SDK 0.2.20.**

item.title: RasanAI Studio 0.12.0 beta 1
item.description: - **The Studio shows the wave 8 data.** The decisions drawer keeps a history of the calls made and shows what the film is working without; lessons can be dropped. - **A Checks popover on the Final page** with the A/B verdicts and the gate numbers, and the film shows its real title. - **Bundles RasanAI 1.17.0:** one argument per film, motion from meaning.

item.title: RasanAI Studio 0.11.0 beta 1
item.description: - **Liquid Glass chrome.** The inspector, action bar and step capsule use the sidebar's own Liquid Glass; the stage no longer lights it. - **Pause freezes the film in place.** Nothing runs and no tokens are used; Resume carries on mid-step with nothing redone. - **The Mac stays awake while a film is made,** a setting on by default. - **Carries on after sleep,** and an automatic resume that came due while asleep runs on wake. - **The brief box grows to 12 lines, then scrolls,** instead of spilling over the page.

item.title: RasanAI Studio 0.10.0 beta 1
item.description: - **Glass that takes its light from the stage.** The inspector and action bar glow with the frame's edge colour, live while the film plays; the glass is solid and untinted. - **Install Claude Code or Codex inside Studio,** with progress in the window; Terminal opens only for sign-in. - **A sidebar that shows where you are.** Icons for each place, Queue in the one group, and recent films with a mark for their state. - **Suggested titles follow the brief,** and never replace a name you typed. - **The film page names the running agent,** and review notes can be skipped before Apply. - **A steadier opening and plainer words,** and clicking a film card opens it again.

item.title: RasanAI Studio 0.9.0 beta 1
item.description: - **Liquid Glass, built for real.** Studio is built against the current macOS SDK, so macOS Tahoe draws its glass chrome itself. - **A native sidebar app.** A system split view with the glass sidebar, which folds and opens with the system animation; folded, the toggle moves into the top bar. - **A proper toolbar.** Back and forward, a glass capsule search, a blue New film button and plain white ••• menus, with no toolbar band in full screen. - **The film page is an editor workspace,** with notes in a right inspector and one status bar for each stage's actions; its main button has no Return shortcut. - **New film uses the whole window,** with compact four-across format tiles, and the move viewer fits its video.

item.title: RasanAI Studio 0.8.2 beta 1
item.description: - **A calmer, more professional finish.** New film is the one loud action on Home, the Home toolbar is icon-only with tooltips, and Story and Look name Claude's pick once, on the option. - **New film footer is one row,** with one secondary button style for Use template, Save as template, Save draft and Discard. - **Footage folder copy fixed.** The footage well now says "Drop a folder of clips" instead of the brand-kit prompt. - **Reopening at launch** returns to the last film only if you quit on a film page; otherwise Studio opens on Home.

item.title: RasanAI Studio 0.8.1 beta 1
item.description: - **Move viewer sound fixed.** The expanded viewer could play a clip twice a few frames apart (an echo) and pause stopped only one copy. There is now one player: one sound, and pause always stops it. - **Silent clips say so.** The viewer shows "No sound in this clip" instead of a mute button that does nothing.

item.title: RasanAI Studio 0.8.0 beta 1
item.description: - **Moves I like.** The Hook / Proof / Turn / Call to action slots are gone: pick up to four moves by taste, each with an optional place, and Claude puts them on the story's beats. - **Expanded moves with sound.** Click a move to watch it large with its audio, with technique filters. - **Moves on the style frames**, with Swap. - **A format picker** ("What are you making?"), notifications when a call is ready, Needs you first on Home, and folder sources. - **A cleaner composer** with a bottom toolbar. - Bundles RasanAI 1.14.0.

item.title: RasanAI Studio 0.7.0 beta 1
item.description: - **Films that keep moving.** Short films are written by one builder and checked frame by frame before you see them; one feature and one scenario per launch film; a faster tempo; real logo files only. - **Get inspired:** a credited gallery of real launch-film moments to start a film from. - **One status line** says whose move it is; the toolbar shows only tokens and cost. - **The Story step** shows what each story achieves. - Fixes: nothing says it is waiting on you after you answer; the running film no longer asks you to stop the director.

item.title: RasanAI Studio 0.6.5 beta 1
item.description: - **Updates download behind security proxies.** The update download now waits up to ten minutes for data instead of 60 seconds. - **Update notes are native text** instead of a web page.

item.title: RasanAI Studio 0.6.4 beta 1
item.description: - **No more flickering text on hover.** Cards and tiles no longer lift, scale or fade their text on hover. - **Scene strip:** chips no longer overlap in a narrow player. - **Decisions inspector** runs the full window height. - **Cursor:** clicking part of the brief no longer leaves the hand cursor stuck. - **Elapsed time** past an hour reads h:mm:ss.
